editorial.blurb: Henrietta delivers consistently excellent American cuisine with warm, anticipatory service that feels like dining among friends.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead for a window table to enjoy the view during a romantic dinner—the bartender and service team will make you feel especially welcomed from the moment you arrive.
